blurb: Statement of Purpose Many great minds throughout the ages have dreamt of creating machines that could perform calculations and solve complex problems. Although many have been involved in the evolution of computer technology, and many machines have come and gone, there are those who stand out as exceptional, remarkable and pivotal in the advances of this exciting field.
